Last month, Anthropic announced plans to expand Claude Cowork from Mac to iPhone and iPad, starting with its most expensive paid plan.

Anthropic stated that as of today, Claude Cowork has fully launched on mobile and desktop versions across all paid plans.

For more details on the release of Anthropic Claude Cowork mobile version, please click here.

Meanwhile, OpenAI has also launched its own offering called ChatGPT Work, available on iPhone, iPad, Mac and the web.
